_comment: First 200 deterministic case-question rows from the canonical trustfoundry-legal-search dataset shipped by the linked @trustfoundry-ai/benchmarks-harness package. Filtered to case rows only, since the openai-legal-search provider adapter only supports doc_type=case + model_type in {case_question, case_key_fact}. Mirrors configs/benchmarks/anthropic-legal-search/case-questions-200.json byte-for-byte apart from datasetSize so the two runs are strictly comparable.
